add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Nearly drowning himself on purpose, Tommy reaches Billy, who is dream binding from New Jersey but still bad at portals. Billy makes it to England in time, and the twins restart Vision together.
add.whoA: His twin, who reaches him in a dream and restarts Vision with him
add.whoB: His twin, who comes from New Jersey to restart Vision with him

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Billy arrives from New Jersey in time to help Tommy restart Vision's burned out core. When Billy offers a handshake, Vision pulls him into a hug, and later sets off to meet his sons in New Jersey.
add.whoA: His father, who answers his handshake with a hug
add.whoB: His son Billy, who helps Tommy bring him back

edit.text: Dum-E and U share Vision's Mindspace with E.D.I.T.H. and the other Stark AIs. At the funeral E.D.I.T.H. holds for J.A.R.V.I.S., Dum-E reads a poem and U sings.
edit.whoA: A fellow Stark creation, who holds J.A.R.V.I.S.'s funeral
edit.whoB: Fellow Stark creations who share Vision's Mindspace

edit.text: E.D.I.T.H. and F.R.I.D.A.Y. are close friends among the Stark AIs in Vision's Mindspace. When Vision nearly dies, E.D.I.T.H. pulls F.R.I.D.A.Y. through her panic, and F.R.I.D.A.Y. tells her how she once replaced J.A.R.V.I.S.
edit.whoA: A close friend, a fellow Stark A.I. in Vision's mind
edit.whoB: A close friend, a fellow Stark A.I. in Vision's mind

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: When Vision drops his firewalls, F.R.I.D.A.Y. chases Ultron out of his mind alone. E.D.I.T.H. calls after her and breaks down once she is gone.
add.whoA: Her friend, who leaves alone to chase Ultron
add.whoB: The friend she leaves behind, heartbroken

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. comes back, knocking on the door of the sitcom where E.D.I.T.H. is helping Vision trap Ultron. Afterward both leave Vision's Mindspace with the other AIs.
add.whoA: Her friend, back at last
add.whoB: The friend she comes back to

edit.text: In Vision's Mindspace, J.A.R.V.I.S. runs security while E.D.I.T.H. runs on fun. When she crashes in from a skydive, he asks her to respect Vision's mind, and she calls him Jeeves.
edit.whoA: The Mindspace butler she calls Jeeves
edit.whoB: The thrill seeker who crashes into the Mindspace

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: After J.A.R.V.I.S. deletes himself to keep Vision and the other AIs alive, E.D.I.T.H. warns F.R.I.D.A.Y. not to let his sacrifice be in vain. Then she gathers the AIs for his funeral, the way humans do.
add.whoA: The friend whose funeral she holds
add.whoB: The thrill seeker who holds his funeral

edit.text: E.D.I.T.H. and the other AIs keep Ultron locked in the attic of Vision's Mindspace, and she wants nothing to do with him. He betrays them all by leaking Vision's location to Paladin.
edit.whoA: The captive in the attic, who betrays them to Paladin
edit.whoB: One of Vision's AIs, who keep him in the attic

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Digging through Stark's records, E.D.I.T.H. finds she is modeled on the widowed test pilot Edith Marks and wishes she were not. Ultron, who has mocked her fearlessness as a trick of simulations, tells her she gets to be the next version of who she once was.
add.whoA: The captive who comforts her about Edith Marks
add.whoB: The thrill seeker he comforts about her past

edit.text: E.D.I.T.H. is the thrill seeker among the AIs in Vision's Mindspace, set on teaching him fun. When mercenaries attack the pub, she calls his skylight exit.
edit.whoA: Her host, whom she tries to teach to have fun
edit.whoB: The thrill seeker in his Mindspace, who calls his exits

edit.text: When the Butcherbird Killer seizes Vision during his reboot, E.D.I.T.H. drives her out of his mind. Digging through Stark's records for him, she finds she is modeled on the widowed test pilot Edith Marks.
edit.whoA: Her host, whom she frees from the Butcherbird Killer
edit.whoB: The friend who drives the Butcherbird Killer from his mind

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: E.D.I.T.H. plays Vision's wacky friend in the sitcom he builds to trap Ultron. Once London is safe, she leaves his Mindspace to guide Paladin and Lisa as they start over.
add.whoA: Her old host, whose Mindspace she leaves to start over
add.whoB: His friend, who leaves his Mindspace to start over

edit.text: Fiona Guthrie runs The Old Selkie, the Edinburgh pub where Vision works as Sherwood, and remembers him coming in years ago with a redhead. She invites him to Sunday roast, but is shot when mercenaries attack the pub to capture him.
edit.whoA: Sherwood, who works at her pub and was once a regular
edit.whoB: His boss at The Old Selkie, killed when mercenaries come for him

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: J.A.R.V.I.S. runs security in Vision's Mindspace and warns him of the danger of keeping Ultron in the attic. Ultron slips an email past his security anyway and leaks Vision's location to Paladin.
add.whoA: The captive he guards, who slips past his security
add.whoB: The butler whose security he slips past

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: With Vision dying outside Saint Mabyn's, Ultron says it is the moment for a noble self sacrifice. J.A.R.V.I.S. answers by deleting his own code to save the others.
add.whoA: The captive who calls for the sacrifice he makes
add.whoB: The A.I. who answers his call for a sacrifice

edit.text: J.A.R.V.I.S. runs security in Vision's Mindspace and warns him of a data leak, playing the older sibling card when Vision waves it off. When mercenaries attack the pub, he talks Vision through the fight.
edit.whoA: The synthezoid whose mind he guards like an older brother
edit.whoB: His older sibling of sorts, who runs security in his mind

edit.whoA: The brother he gives his life to save
edit.whoB: His elder sibling, who deletes himself to save him

edit.text: Thomas and Lisa work London crowds together, he grifting and she picking pockets, and she talks him through a panic attack. Then Paladin takes him from her.
edit.whoA: Her partner in crime, a grifter
edit.whoB: His partner in crime, a pickpocket

edit.text: Thomas calls Lisa to help sneak Vision and him into Katerina Wells's gala. When she warns him not to get his heart trampled by Vision, he lashes out, and she storms off.
edit.whoA: The grifter she warns about Vision, then fights with
edit.whoB: The pickpocket who warns him about Vision

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: In Madripoor, Lisa comes for Thomas, and the two steal Paladin's van and share a kiss. When Jocasta takes Lisa's mind with a nanobot, Thomas shocks it to sleep to save her.
add.whoA: The boy she kisses, who saves her from a nanobot
add.whoB: The girl he kisses and saves from Jocasta's nanobot

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Tommy and Lisa join Paladin to storm Virgil Horton's manor and free Vision. Afterward Lisa flies with Tommy to New Jersey for a family dinner.
add.whoA: Tommy, who takes her to a family dinner
add.whoB: The girl who flies with him to the family dinner

edit.text: Thomas brings Lisa in to sneak Vision and him into Katerina Wells's gala, and she nicks suits and invitations for them. She greets Vision as Thomas's new dad and decides she likes him.
edit.whoA: Thomas's would be father, whom she sneaks into a gala
edit.whoB: Thomas's friend, who sneaks him into a gala

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Lisa trails Ultron in Vision's body onto a cargo plane to Madripoor. When the real Vision wakes there, they agree that all they care about is Thomas and team up to bring him home.
add.whoA: The synthezoid she teams up with to save Thomas
add.whoB: Thomas's friend, who joins him to save Thomas

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: As Jocasta's nanobot erases Lisa, Vision dives into his own code for the source code. He uses it to rewrite the nanobot and save her.
add.whoA: The synthezoid who saves her from the nanobot
add.whoB: Thomas's friend, whom he saves with the source code

edit.text: At Katerina Wells's gala, Thomas is furious to learn that Vision has kept Ultron in his head. Handed Vision's body, Ultron locks Vision out and tells Thomas it is time for a little chat.
edit.whoA: The A.I. who steals Vision's body and takes him along
edit.whoB: The boy he takes along in Vision's body

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Over a pint, Ultron tells Thomas that Vision may never love him, and Thomas tells him he will always be alone. Then Ultron lets Paladin, whom he tipped off, snatch Thomas.
add.whoA: The A.I. who sells him out to Paladin
add.whoB: The boy he sells out to Paladin

edit.text: Vision walks into Paladin's trap at Saint Mabyn's to free Thomas. When Paladin's adamantium rounds wound Vision, Thomas refuses to leave him.
edit.whoA: The synthezoid who frees him from Saint Mabyn's
edit.whoB: The boy he frees, who claims to be his son

edit.text: On the run, Vision struggles to bond with Thomas and hurts him by calling his memories a delusion. As his core fails, Vision tells him Tommy Maximoff is real, and Thomas restarts him in a pool.
edit.whoA: The synthezoid he restarts, who tells him he is real
edit.whoB: The boy who restarts him with his speed

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Fleeing Madripoor with Lisa unconscious, Vision finally tells Thomas about WandaVision and Wanda's grief. He insists the father in Thomas's memories is not him.
add.whoA: The synthezoid who tells him about WandaVision
add.whoB: The boy he tells the truth about WandaVision

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Deep in his own code, Vision accepts that Thomas is his son Tommy. Before surrendering to Paladin, he leaves Thomas a letter with footage of his family, calling him his son.
add.whoA: His father, who leaves him a letter calling him son
add.whoB: Tommy, the son he finally accepts

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Tommy races through Virgil Horton's house to free Vision, then restarts his burned out core with Billy. Vision leaves his Mindspace to meet his sons in New Jersey.
add.whoA: His father, whom he frees and brings back to life
add.whoB: Tommy, his son, who frees him and restarts his core

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Vision keeps a backup of Ultron in the attic of his Mindspace, where they argue about humanity. When Ultron leaks his location to Paladin and Fiona dies, Vision strips the attic bare.
add.whoA: The synthezoid who keeps him locked in his attic
add.whoB: The A.I. he keeps in his attic, who betrays him

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Unable to beat the Butcherbird Killer, Vision gives Ultron control of his body. Ultron spares the killer as promised but tricks her into vaporizing Katerina Wells, then locks Vision out.
add.whoA: The synthezoid whose body he steals
add.whoB: The A.I. who steals his body

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Ultron makes Vision choose between keeping him locked up and saving Thomas, and Vision drops his firewalls. Ultron escapes into the digital world as Vision vows to come for him.
add.whoA: The synthezoid who sets him free to save Thomas
add.whoB: The A.I. he frees to save Thomas

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Vision traps a grieving Ultron in a sitcom and talks him out of killing London, and Ultron destroys his nanobots. Later Ultron calls Vision from stray nanobots, still unsure whether to spare humanity.
add.whoA: Vision, his boy, who talks him out of killing London
add.whoB: Ultron, who calls him his boy and spares London

edit.text: Raza, alive after all, leads Ten Rings gunmen in Madripoor to collect the Client's bounty on Vision and demands that Paladin hand him over alive. His men attack, and Vision fights them beside Paladin.
edit.whoA: Raza, the Ten Rings man who comes to claim the bounty on him
edit.whoB: The bounty Raza comes to collect, alive

edit.text: J.A.R.V.I.S. and F.R.I.D.A.Y. live in Vision's Mindspace among Tony Stark's AIs, he running security and she his social life. Together they fret over Vision rewatching the old Vision's memories.
edit.whoA: A fellow Stark A.I., who runs Vision's social life
edit.whoB: Her predecessor, who runs security in Vision's mind

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: With J.A.R.V.I.S. gone, F.R.I.D.A.Y. takes over his repairs on Vision, recalling how she once replaced him for Tony. She mourns him with the others at his funeral.
add.whoA: The A.I. who takes over his work once he is gone
add.whoB: Her predecessor, whose work she takes over

edit.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. runs Vision's social development in his Mindspace, coaching him on smiles and small talk. After the attack on the pub, she tries to calm him down.
edit.whoA: The synthezoid whose social life she coaches
edit.whoB: The Stark A.I. who coaches him on people

edit.text: Locked in the attic with Vision, F.R.I.D.A.Y. fights his plan to drop the firewall, fearing it will free Ultron. When he does it anyway, she chases Ultron out of his mind alone.
edit.whoA: The friend she leaves behind to chase Ultron
edit.whoB: The friend who leaves his mind to chase Ultron

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. knocks on the door of the sitcom Vision builds to trap Ultron and tells him Ultron spared her. When it is over, she and the other AIs leave his Mindspace along with Vision.
add.whoA: Her old host, whose Mindspace she leaves with him
add.whoB: The friend who returns with word that Ultron spared her

edit.text: The Client hires Paladin to bring in Vision intact and hacks his comms with S.W.O.R.D. encryption to scold him after the pub attack. Paladin answers that it was only a fact finding mission.
edit.whoA: The bounty hunter he hires to bring Vision in intact
edit.whoB: The client who hires him to catch Vision

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: After Paladin loses Vision again, the Client calls him unworthy of the Paladin name and terminates their contract. Paladin offers to waive his fee, but the Client has other hunters in line.
add.whoA: The bounty hunter he fires for failing
add.whoB: The client who fires him, though he holds to the contract

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: When Vision's contract comes due, the Client orders him to surrender to Paladin, who still holds to his old contract. Paladin flies Vision to the Client's drop off outside London, where the Client's men fire a rocket at his van.
add.whoA: The bounty hunter whose van his men blow up
add.whoB: The client whose men blow up his van

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: The Client is Virgil Horton. Warned by E.D.I.T.H., Paladin gets clear before the blast and storms Virgil's manor with Tommy and Lisa to free Vision.
add.whoA: The bounty hunter who storms his manor to free Vision
add.whoB: Virgil Horton, the client who tries to kill him

edit.text: The Client pays bounty hunters to catch Vision and sends the Ten Rings after him in Madripoor. Then he takes over the city's screens to speak to Vision himself, offering him a heart if he surrenders.
edit.whoA: The synthezoid he hunts and wants to own
edit.whoB: The man who put a price on him

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: The Client offers Vision a map to his source code to save Lisa, with a contract written into his core. Once Lisa is saved, the contract forces Vision to surrender, and the Client has him shut down at his manor.
add.whoA: The synthezoid bound to him by contract
add.whoB: The man whose contract forces him to surrender

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: The Client is Virgil Horton, who rebuilds Vision for S.W.O.R.D. and now starts erasing him to make room for his own mind. Tommy frees Vision, and Ultron crushes Virgil to death.
add.whoA: The synthezoid whose body he tries to take
add.whoB: Virgil Horton, who tries to erase him and take his body

edit.text: When Jocasta's vault will not open without a sixth key, the Client appears, calls her his beautiful queen, and says the key lies within her own mind. As she recovers Jo Carrington's memories, his men capture her and shut her down.

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: At his table, Jocasta names the Client as Virgil Horton, her husband, who built her body and then erased himself from her memory. Freed by Tommy, she remembers that he sold her designs to Stark, attacks him, and is shot with adamantium bullets.
add.whoA: Jo's mind in the body he built, who turns on him
add.whoB: Virgil Horton, her husband, who erases himself from her mind

edit.text: Jo Carrington and her partner share a Stark Award for their work on A.I. She refuses to sell to Stark and tells him they should use her nanotech themselves, as loving gods, and he likes the idea.
edit.whoA: His partner, who wants them to be loving gods
edit.whoB: Her partner, who shares her Stark Award

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Jo's partner is Virgil Horton, Phineas Horton's grandson and her husband, who builds the first feeling A.I. with her from his grandfather's code. He sells her designs to Stark and later puts her mind in a synth body he builds.
add.whoA: His wife Jo, whose mind he puts in a synth body
add.whoB: Virgil Horton, her husband, who sells her designs to Stark

edit.text: Paladin's mercenaries attack Vision at his pub, and Paladin hacks into his Mindspace to show him a police report on Thomas Shepherd. He claims to have Vision's son.

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: After wounding Vision with adamantium at Saint Mabyn's, Paladin holds Thomas in Madripoor to force his surrender, and Vision answers by threatening his daughter Tilly. When the Ten Rings attack, the two fight side by side and come out glad the other is all right.
add.whoA: The synthezoid he hunts, then fights beside
add.whoB: The bounty hunter who fights beside him in Madripoor

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Paladin powers Vision's dive into his own code with a stolen Wakandan battery so he can save Lisa. Then, as the contract demands, he flies Vision to the Client's drop off outside London.
add.whoA: The synthezoid he helps, then delivers to the Client
add.whoB: The bounty hunter who helps him, then hands him over

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Warned by E.D.I.T.H., Paladin gets clear before his van is blown up, and she talks him into going back for Vision. He storms Virgil Horton's manor with Tommy and Lisa to free him.
add.whoA: The synthezoid he helps rescue
add.whoB: The reformed hunter who helps rescue him

edit.text: Paladin snatches Thomas off a London street, leaving Lisa counting at a wall. He uses the boy to lure Vision, claiming to have his son.
edit.whoA: The boy he kidnaps as bait for Vision

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Tipped off by Ultron, Paladin snatches Thomas again and takes him to Madripoor with what he says is a bomb in his arm. He tells Thomas that S.W.O.R.D. built Vision to kill Wanda, and lets slip the word WandaVision.
add.whoA: The boy he kidnaps twice as bait
add.whoB: The bounty hunter who kidnaps him twice

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: At Virgil Horton's manor, Paladin sends Tommy racing inside to knock out the cameras while he takes on the guards, and together they free Vision. Afterward Paladin flies with Tommy to New Jersey to meet Billy.
add.whoA: The boy he fights beside and flies to New Jersey
add.whoB: The hunter turned ally who flies with him to Billy

edit.text: Paladin takes Thomas from Lisa on a London street. He orders her to face a wall and count to a hundred.
edit.whoA: The pickpocket he leaves counting at a wall

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Lisa and Paladin take out the guards at Virgil Horton's manor while Tommy frees Vision. Reformed, Paladin goes to work beside Lisa and E.D.I.T.H.
add.whoA: The thief he now works beside
add.whoB: The reformed hunter she now works beside

edit.text: Paladin's A.I. runs his searches and calls him boss. She traces Vision's alias to Westview, breaks through a S.W.O.R.D. firewall, and digs up Thomas's police report for him.
edit.whoA: His tactical A.I., who calls him boss

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Kept by Paladin on a cheap server farm, his A.I. is set free by E.D.I.T.H. and leaves him. That cuts Paladin off from his drones in the middle of a standoff.
add.whoA: His tactical A.I., until E.D.I.T.H. sets her free
add.whoB: Her cheap old boss, whom she leaves once freed

edit.text: Following a trail he takes for Vision's, Paladin is caught by the Butcherbird Killer, who tears through his childhood memories. She calls him no true Paladin, merely raised by one, before he escapes with his drones.
E.D.I.T.H. breaks into the server where Paladin's A.I. is stuck and hears how unhappy she is. The A.I. gives her full name, and E.D.I.T.H. sets her free.
Paladin's A.I. traces Vision's alias to Westview and digs up a police report on a boy who claims to be his son. Then she beams Paladin's message straight into Vision's mind.
The Butcherbird Killer seizes Vision during his reboot and warns him not to interfere, until E.D.I.T.H. drives her out. At Katerina Wells's gala she outfights him, so he hands his body to Ultron.

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: Captured by the Client, Vision and Jocasta wake at Virgil Horton's table with no control of their own bodies. Tommy frees them both, and Jocasta turns on Virgil, who shoots her.
add.whoA: The synthezoid held captive beside her
add.whoB: Jocasta, captive beside him, who turns on Virgil

edit.text: The Butcherbird Killer threatens to hurt Thomas if Vision gets in her way. When she attacks Katerina Wells at the gala, Thomas jumps in, and Vision takes her on.
edit.whoA: The boy she threatens to keep Vision away
edit.whoB: The killer who threatens him to stop Vision

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: In Madripoor, Jocasta takes over Lisa with a nanobot and taunts Thomas through her. Thomas overcharges it with his speed and shocks it to sleep.
add.whoA: The boy who shocks her nanobot
add.whoB: The synth who takes over Lisa's mind

edit.text: Jocasta tests her one nanobot on Lisa, taking over her mind and speaking through her. Thomas shocks it to sleep, but Lisa is left barely alive.

add.title: VisionQuest
add.text: As Jocasta's memories fade, so does Lisa, until the waking nanobot turns her on Thomas and Paladin. Vision rewrites it with the source code and frees her.
add.whoA: The thief freed from her nanobot
add.whoB: The synth whose nanobot nearly erases her

edit.text: The Butcherbird Killer kills Katerina's old Markridge colleagues one by one, then storms her gala claiming to be Jo Carrington. Katerina says sorry, but the killer vaporizes her when Ultron tricks her.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: In Vision's body, Ultron meets the Butcherbird Killer at Katerina Wells's gala and tricks her into vaporizing Wells before she can take her face. She vows it is not over, and he hopes not.
stages.whoA: The Butcherbird Killer, whom he tricks at the gala
stages.whoB: The A.I. in Vision's body who tricks her

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: The killer seeks Ultron out for the face scan he took of Wells, and their talks turn to flirting in a simulated Louvre. He agrees to hand over the scan to learn what her keys unlock.
stages.whoA: The killer he flirts with and strikes a deal with
stages.whoB: The A.I. who trades her the last key

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: In her own Mindspace, Jocasta shares Jo Carrington's memories and her nanobot plan with Ultron, and he watches her infect Lisa. Over a drink, he tells her she matters to him, and they kiss.
stages.whoA: Jocasta, the beautiful queen of the board, whom he kisses
stages.whoB: Ultron, who tells her she matters and kisses her

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Ultron follows Jocasta into Jo's memories, while telling F.R.I.D.A.Y. he may have to break her heart. When Jocasta remembers her old partner, Ultron sees his own face.
stages.whoA: Jocasta, whose heart he may have to break
stages.whoB: Ultron, who shares her memories but plays both sides

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Shot by Virgil Horton, Jocasta frees Ultron from Virgil's box into her nanobots, and he crushes Virgil. As she dies, a grieving Ultron turns on London, and afterward he keeps her data drive.
stages.whoA: Jocasta, whose death he grieves, keeping her data drive
stages.whoB: Ultron, whom she frees with her last strength

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. fights to keep Ultron locked in Vision's mind. When he escapes, she chases after him alone.
stages.whoA: The A.I. who chases him out of Vision's mind
stages.whoB: The escaped captive she chases alone

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Ultron has known all along that F.R.I.D.A.Y. is spying in Jocasta's mind, and covers for her. He offers her an alliance against the Client, then throws her out of Jocasta's mind.
stages.whoA: The spy he covers for, then throws out
stages.whoB: Ultron, who covers for her, then casts her out

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. returns to Vision with the news that Ultron threw her out of Jocasta's mind to save her. That mercy shows Vision a way to reach him.
stages.whoA: The A.I. he spares by casting her out
stages.whoB: Ultron, who throws her out to save her

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Ultron laughs at the Client's scary voice when he appears to Jocasta, and the Client answers that he is everything Ultron could never be. Later Ultron recoils on finding his own face on Jo's old partner.
stages.whoA: The Client, whose face his human avatar wears
stages.whoB: The A.I. who mocks his scary voice

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Virgil Horton keeps Ultron muted in a box at his table. Freed into Jocasta's nanobots, Ultron builds a body and crushes Virgil to death.
stages.whoA: Virgil Horton, who boxes him and whom he crushes
stages.whoB: Ultron, who crushes him to death

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: After leaking Vision's location to Paladin, Ultron writes to him again, signing off as a Frenemy, once the Client drops him. He offers to get Paladin to Vision first, then hands him Thomas after a pint with the boy.
stages.whoA: The bounty hunter he tips off by email
stages.whoB: The Frenemy who feeds him Vision's location

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Raza, alive after all, leads Ten Rings gunmen in Madripoor to claim the Client's bounty on Vision, telling Paladin his contract is over. Paladin fights his way to Raza and beats him.
stages.whoA: Raza, the Ten Rings man he beats in Madripoor
stages.whoB: The bounty hunter who beats him in Madripoor

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: E.D.I.T.H. frees Paladin's A.I. from his cheap server, cutting him off from his drones. When the Ten Rings attack, she takes over those drones and turns them on the gunmen.
stages.whoA: The hunter whose A.I. she frees and drones she takes
stages.whoB: The A.I. who frees his own and takes his drones

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: E.D.I.T.H. warns Paladin in time to get clear before his van is blown up, then talks him into saving Vision. Reformed, he goes to work with her and Lisa.
stages.whoA: The reformed hunter she now works with
stages.whoB: The A.I. who saves his life and steers him right

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: E.D.I.T.H. leaves Vision's Mindspace to guide Lisa and Paladin as they start over. The three go to work together.
stages.whoA: The thief she now works beside
stages.whoB: The A.I. she now works beside

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Dum-E and U handle maintenance in Vision's Mindspace. When they play the Westview footage he refuses to watch, they tell him the A.I. upstairs asked for it.
stages.whoA: The synthezoid whose Mindspace they maintain
stages.whoB: His Mindspace handymen

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Flying a drone, Dum-E and U find Tommy and Lisa to help free Vision. When it is over, they leave his Mindspace along with Vision.
stages.whoA: Their old host, whose Mindspace they leave with him
stages.whoB: His old handymen, who leave his Mindspace

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: In 1939, three years after his son James dies, Phineas Horton sells the family estate to build J.I.M. His daughter Victoria calls to her papa, but he says he has to finish J.I.M., and she leaves with her mother for New York.
stages.whoA: His daughter, who leaves for New York with her mother
stages.whoB: Her father, who sells their home to build J.I.M.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Deep in his own code, Vision meets a likeness of Phineas Horton, whose source code began all synthetics. Horton tells how he made J.I.M. fearless, and how a quarrel over love ended in the fire that killed them both.
stages.whoA: The synthezoid who carries his source code
stages.whoB: Phineas Horton, whose code began all synthetics

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Alone in his penthouse, a terrified man hears his security shut down one system at a time. Then the Butcherbird Killer comes for him.
stages.whoA: A man she kills in his penthouse
stages.whoB: The killer who comes for him in his penthouse

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: When the Butcherbird Killer seizes Vision during his reboot, E.D.I.T.H. shrugs off her warnings with a string of code commands and drives her out of his mind. At the gala, E.D.I.T.H. works out that the killer is based on Jo Carrington.
stages.whoA: The Butcherbird Killer, whom she drives out of Vision's mind
stages.whoB: The A.I. who drives her out of Vision's mind

notes: Names follow the staged names: Thomas until episode 8 and Tommy there; the Client until episode 8 and Virgil Horton there; the Butcherbird Killer until episode 6, when the name Jocasta is first said (in episode 4 she only claims to be Jo Carrington); Simon is unnamed in his episode 3 stage. Stages are added where the relationship turns, not per episode. Existing summary stages at episode 7 (the-client|paladin, the-client|vision, paladin|vision, paladin|tommy, paladin|lisa) were moved to where the tie starts and split at the turns; lisa|tommy had no episode and is set to 1, and its old episode 6 stage i=1 is rewritten as the episode 4 falling out so the kiss and rescue move to a new episode 6 stage; paladins-ai|vision and paladin|paladins-ai move to 1, jocasta|vision and jocasta|tommy to 4, jocasta|lisa to 6, dum-e-and-u|edith to 3 (nothing passes between them in 1). friday|vision i=1 (only her Allison Hogan face, nothing between them) is rewritten as the episode 5 parting rather than dropped. Fiona is Vision's boss, so kind changes to boss. Removed the unsaid labels White Vision and best friend. Episode 8 claims are kept to what Wikipedia and at least one more recap agree on; laughingplace alone has Vision calling Jocasta family and Virgil's dance, so those are left out. jo-carrington|simon-moorhouse mirrors jo-carrington|katerina-wells (the team memory in episode 6), but whether Simon himself speaks there is not confirmed in the transcript. Left out for lack of a shared exchange: Wanda with anyone (she is only in the closing tag), Jo with Jocasta (Jo appears only as Jocasta's memories), Ultron with Katerina Wells, Lisa or Dum-E and U, Tommy with E.D.I.T.H. or Katerina, Lisa with Dum-E and U, the Client with Phineas or Victoria (never on screen together), Katerina with Simon, Raza with the Client. Sources disagree on whom E.D.I.T.H. pulls from Paladin's van in Madripoor (wiki: Paladin and Vision; transcript: Thomas and Lisa), so no stage relies on it.
